approval.title: An AI assistant wants to use your browser

summary.mockReplace: Replace the fake network responses on {{origin}} with: {{rules}}
summary.record: Record a video of {{origin}}, saved to your Downloads and to Wysebee

recording.title: Recording saved
recording.message: Pictures of what the agent did in this browser, an animated GIF and WebP, and a Playwright test of the steps are in {{folder}}

common.workerDown: The extension's background worker is not answering. Reload the extension.

requests.intro: A blocked request is refused on every site, trusted ones included, without asking you.
requests.bookmarksAllow: Allow without asking — every bookmark URL, on request, with no prompt.
requests.recordUpload: Also upload each video to Wysebee for replay — it can show anything on the tab.

browser_tabs.label: List your tabs
browser_tabs.hint: Titles and sites of open tabs.

browser_snapshot.label: Read pages
browser_snapshot.hint: The text and structure of a page.

browser_screenshot.label: Take screenshots
browser_screenshot.hint: An image of the visible tab.

browser_bookmarks.label: Read bookmarks
browser_bookmarks.hint: Full URLs, and not covered by any site's level — they belong to no site.

browser_click.label: Click
browser_click.hint: Click an element on a page.

browser_type.label: Type
browser_type.hint: Type into a field on a page.

browser_scroll.label: Scroll
browser_scroll.hint: Scroll a page or an element.

browser_mouse.label: Use the mouse
browser_mouse.hint: Press, move and release, simulated in the page.

native_input.label: Use the mouse with real input
native_input.hint: Through the browser's debugger, indistinguishable from you.

browser_activate.label: Switch tabs
browser_activate.hint: Bring a tab to the front.

browser_console.label: Read the console
browser_console.hint: Logs, warnings, errors and uncaught exceptions.

browser_network.label: Read network activity
browser_network.hint: Requests, statuses and timings. Sign-in headers and cookies are hidden.

browser_network_body.label: Read response bodies
browser_network_body.hint: What a request got back from the server.

browser_evaluate.label: Run JavaScript
browser_evaluate.hint: Run script in the page, as in the DevTools console. The prompt shows the script.

browser_viewport.label: Change the window size
browser_viewport.hint: Emulate a phone, tablet or another screen size.

browser_inspect.label: Inspect elements
browser_inspect.hint: Styles, size, position and HTML of an element.

browser_audit.label: Audit pages
browser_audit.hint: Check accessibility, SEO and common mistakes.

browser_performance.label: Measure performance
browser_performance.hint: Load timings, paints, layout shift and memory.

browser_reload.label: Reload pages
browser_reload.hint: Reload a tab, optionally skipping the cache.

browser_mock.label: Fake network responses
browser_mock.hint: Answer chosen requests with an error, a made-up reply or a delay, to test error handling. Asks every time unless the site allows everything. Off until you turn it on.

browser_record.label: Record videos
browser_record.hint: Film a tab while the agent works through a scenario. Saved to Downloads/Wysebee Agent. Off until you turn it on.

sites.intro: These sites may be used without asking. Everything else asks you first. Only http and https pages can be controlled.
sites.invalid: Enter an http or https site, such as localhost:3000 or example.com.
sites.saveFailed: Only an http or https site can be added.
sites.none: None yet. Add one above, or choose “Always allow” on a prompt.

auto.label: Trusted
auto.hint: Runs without asking; closing one of your tabs still asks.

full.label: Allow everything
full.hint: Also closes tabs without asking. For a web app under automated test.

language.label: Language
language.hint: For this extension in this browser.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: For this extension in this browser.

server.label: Wysebee Cloud server
server.intro: The Wysebee Cloud this browser pairs with. To use a self-hosted Wysebee, enter its address here, then pair.
server.hint: An https address, or http for this computer or a private network (localhost, 10.x, 172.16–31.x, 192.168.x, .local).
server.invalid: Enter an https address, such as https://wysebee.example.com. Plain http is only for this computer or a private network.
server.saveFailed: The server could not be saved.
server.confirm: A pairing belongs to its server: changing to {{server}} unpairs this browser. Pair it again afterwards.

pair.intro: Pair this browser with Wysebee. Pairing creates a new agent, and only that agent can use this browser.
pair.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to 60 characters, on one line.
pair.codeHelp: Type this code in Wysebee: Devices → Pair a browser
pair.expired: The code ran out before anyone typed it.
pair.unpairedNotice: This browser was unpaired in Wysebee, or its agent was deleted.
pair.failed: Wysebee could not be reached at {{server}}. Check your connection and try again.

refused.name_taken: An agent already has that name.
refused.too_many: You already have 20 agents. Delete one in Wysebee, then pair again.
refused.invalid_name: That name cannot be used. It needs to start with a letter.

link.enabledHint: Wysebee can use this browser, as the sites and permissions below allow.
link.disabledHint: Off: Wysebee cannot use this browser and nothing is kept open to it. You stay paired: switch it back on to carry on.

unpair.confirm: Unpair this browser? The agent “{{label}}” stays in Wysebee, without a browser.
unpair.hint: Stops Wysebee using this browser. To use it again, pair it as a new agent.
